title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a user can register successfully with valid required details and receives JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page
Input valid personal or business registration details for seller or company
Submit the registration form
Validate response confirms registration success
Verify received JWT token for authentication

title: User Registration Validation Errors
description: Verify registration fails with appropriate errors for missing or invalid required fields.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page
Submit registration with empty or invalid data
Ensure validation error messages are returned for required fields

title: User Login Success
description: Verify user can login with valid credentials and receives JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Submit login form
Login is successful and JWT token is issued

title: User Login Failure
description: Verify login fails with incorrect credentials and shows error message.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid username/email or wrong password
Submit login form
Login fails with appropriate error message

title: User Profile Update Success
description: Verify logged-in user can update profile details successfully.

steps.description: Login as existing user
Navigate to profile management page
Update profile information (name, contact details, etc.)
Submit updated profile
Profile updates are saved and reflected correctly

title: KYC Document Upload and Verification Workflow
description: Verify that seller can upload selfie and Aadhaar documents, triggering AI-based biometric verification and status updates.

steps.description: Login as seller role
Navigate to identity verification page
Upload selfie image and Aadhaar document files
Submit for verification
Uploaded files are stored securely
AI biometric face matching process is triggered
Verification status updates to pending, then approved or rejected based on AI output

title: KYC Verification Failure with Invalid Documents
description: Verify the system rejects invalid or corrupt documents and prevents verification approval.

steps.description: Login as seller role
Navigate to identity verification page
Upload corrupt or invalid document files
Submit documents for verification
System rejects documents and shows clear error messages
Verification status remains unapproved

title: Green Property CRUD Operations
description: Verify create, read, update, and delete operations function correctly for green properties with geotagged images and boundary coordinates.

steps.description: Login as verified seller
Navigate to property-verification page
Create a new property with valid details including boundary coordinates and geotagged images
Property is created and details stored correctly
Retrieve property details
Property details including coordinates and images are accurate
Update property details and images
Updated property information is saved and reflected
Delete the property
Property is removed from system

title: Carbon Coin Wallet Balance and Transaction History Accuracy
description: Verify that wallet balances correctly reflect transactions and that the transaction history is complete and accurate.

steps.description: Login as verified user with Carbon Coin wallet
View wallet balance
Displayed wallet balance matches backend data
View transaction history
All past transactions appear with correct details and timestamps

title: Carbon Coin Transfer Between Verified Users
description: Verify coin transfers between users succeed only if both participants are verified, and balances update accordingly.

steps.description: Login as a verified user
Attempt to transfer Carbon Coins to another verified user
Transfer succeeds and wallet balances update for both users
Attempt to transfer coins to unverified user
Transfer is blocked with error indicating recipient must be verified
Attempt to transfer more coins than available balance
Transfer fails with insufficient balance error

title: Company Registration and Document Upload
description: Verify companies can register, upload registration documents and logos, and edit their profiles.

steps.description: Navigate to company registration page
Fill in company details and submit registration
Company profile is created successfully
Upload company logo and registration documents
Documents are saved securely and associated with company profile
Edit company profile details
Updated company profile information is saved and reflected

title: Admin User Management and Verification Approval Workflow
description: Verify admin functionalities include viewing users, approving/rejecting identity verifications, and managing platform users.

steps.description: Login as administrator
Access user management interface
View list of users with statuses
Select pending identity verification request
Approve verification after review
User verification status updates to approved
Reject a verification request
Verification status updates to rejected with reason

title: Admin Property Oversight and Management
description: Verify admin can view, approve, or reject properties and manage property data.

steps.description: Login as administrator
Navigate to property management dashboard
View property listings with details and verification statuses
Approve a property after examination
Property verification status updates to approved
Reject a property submission
Property status updates to rejected with proper logging

title: Secure File Upload via Cloudinary Integration
description: Verify that images and documents are uploaded securely using Cloudinary and validated at backend.

steps.description: Attempt to upload valid image and document files during profile, KYC, property, or company workflows
Files are uploaded without errors and URLs are stored securely
Attempt to upload disallowed file types or excessively large files
Uploads are rejected with validation errors

title: Frontend UI Rendering and API Communication
description: Verify frontend pages and reusable components render correctly and communicate with backend APIs seamlessly.

steps.description: Access signup, login, dashboard, verify-identity, property-verification pages in browser
All pages load without errors and display components properly
Perform actions on frontend such as registration, login, profile update, document upload, property CRUD
Frontend sends correct API requests and handles responses successfully
UI updates reflect changes from backend responses appropriately
